data.name: Greeting
data.value: Greetings, warrior! Until your first reset I can raise your damage and defense. I can also tell you how things work in this world.

data.name: TopicsIntro
data.value: What would you like to know?

data.name: Overhead
data.value: New here? Ask me, I'll tell you about this world!

data.name: ResetsText
data.value: Reset at level 400 for 100,000,000 zen: type /reset, or click Leo the Helper in Lorencia twice. You stay in the game, at level 10 in your home town, with your items, skills and quests.;Your stats go back to the class start, and you get 500 free points for every reset made: 5,000 at the 10th reset. The levels up to 400 add their points on top.;Experience: x500 up to 10 resets, x400 from the 11th, x300 from the 21st, x250 from the 31st. No Happy Hour. A kill gives at most one level. /rate shows yours.;/resetstats gives back every point for 1,000,000 zen, in a safe zone. Resets have no limit.

data.name: TiersText
data.value: Tier Maps are the endgame: a 20-minute run through a fortress, waves of guards and a boss at the end. Talk to Jerint the Assistant in Lorencia or Devias.;The ticket is a Gaion's Order: 5 Suspicious Scraps of Paper from Blood Castle, Devil Square, Kalima and bosses join into one. The party leader uses it.;3 runs a day per character. The party's average Combat Power must reach the tier's mark (tier 1: 10,000, tier 6: 32,000), each member at least 70 % of it and the tier's HP. Two need 15 % more, solo 30 %.;Bosses drop ancient items, Jewel of Ancient (tiers 4-6), Flame of Condor and experience.

data.name: TowerText
data.value: The Endless Tower is at Lugard, next to Jerint in Lorencia and Devias. A party of 3 to 5, each pays 5,000,000 zen. 2 runs a day, new ones at 00:00 UTC.;30 minutes of waves, a boss every 10th wave. A fast clear skips waves. If you die, you stand up again after 3 seconds.;Rewards: jewels by your height straight into the jewel bank (K), and a Box of Kundun from every boss and golden monster.;Tower points (your height + 10 a boss) buy items in Lugard's shop. The ranking counts your best wave, by week and by season, with prizes.

data.name: EventsText
data.value: Press O for the timer of every event, or type /events. Times are UTC: Moldova is 2 hours ahead in winter, 3 in summer.;Blood Castle every hour at :00, Devil Square at :30, Chaos Castle at 02, 06, 10, 14, 18 and 22. Blood Castle and Devil Square also give scraps for the Tier Maps.;Golden Invasion every 4 hours from 00:00: every golden monster drops a box. White Wizard every 2 hours from 12:00 to 22:00, Red Dragons at 02, 08, 14 and 20.;Kanturu with Nightmare at 18:00, Crywolf on Wednesday and Saturday at 20:45.

data.name: PvpText
data.value: PvP events run on the Vulcanus arena, level 50 or a reset. There you hit without Ctrl, and a kill makes no PK.;The Crown (/crown) at 13:40 and 19:40: hold the ring, the winner gets a Box of Kundun +3. Team Fight (/tdm) at 18:40: winners get a Box +3. Guild Throne (/throne) on weekends at 19:10.;Vulcanus opens, with the Fire Lord, when the server fills its gauge (level 150 or a reset). Guild Week: the top 3 guilds get boxes.;Ranked duels: /duelstart, with a rating and jewel bets.;World boss at 16:45 in Lorencia. A rift may open as you hunt: close it with your party in 3 minutes for a chest.

data.name: PassText
data.value: The battle pass is 50 reward levels for your whole account, 1,000 points each. Press X for its window, or type /bp.;Points: 150 for 15 minutes of play a day, 200 each for the first 3 of the 10 daily quests, plus weekly and season quests. 3, 6 and 10 dailies done give chests.;Claim rewards with /bpclaim, or /bptake if the bag is full. Swap a daily you don't like with /bpreroll and its number, once a day.;Right now, after the wipe, the pass is paused. The test season starts on Sunday, 1 November, at 18:00 UTC (20:00 in Chisinau).

data.name: DailyText
data.value: Press N for the daily rewards. Play 15 minutes a day on any character of your account, the minutes add up.;A row of 7 days, from a Jewel of Bless to a Box of Kundun +4. A counted day's reward goes straight into your inventory.;Miss a day and the row starts over at day 1. After day 7 it begins again.;Bag full? The reward waits. Make room and press Take in the N window, or type /daily. Days change at 00:00 UTC.

data.name: TradeText
data.value: There are no personal stores: the auction takes their place, at Raul the Auctioneer in Lorencia and in Devias next to Baz.;Prices are in jewels only, never zen: a buyout in up to 3 kinds of jewels, or bids, each 5 % over the last. You pay from your jewel bank.;A lot stays 1, 3 or 7 days, up to 10 lots per account. The fee is 10,000,000 zen a day, not returned.;Jewel bank: K with the inventory open, up to 1,000,000 of each jewel per account. The vault at Baz in the towns has 8 free pages, shared by your characters.

data.name: GearText
data.value: Excellent items drop from 1 % of kills, with 1-4 options. Boxes of Kundun +1 to +4 (golden monsters) always hold one. A Box +5 gives an excellent item with 2-3 options or an ancient, plus jewels for the bank.;Ancient items: the bosses of Kalima 6 and 7 (a Lost Map from 5 Symbols of Kundun), Tier Maps bosses and Nightmare.;Jewel of Ancient (Tier Maps 4-6, Nightmare) takes an ancient item to +14 and +15 at the Chaos Goblin. A whole set at +14 gives stats +5 % and a gold glow, at +15 even +10 %.;A Jewel of Fate makes a +10 to +15 upgrade certain. It comes from the battle pass and ranking prizes.

data.name: HelperText
data.value: The MU Helper is free for everyone. Z opens its settings: hunting range, skills, buffs, potions and pickup. Home starts and stops it, outside a safe zone.;It fights, buffs, drinks potions and picks up items while the game is open, even minimized. There is no offline levelling.;Combat Power (CP) is one number for your strength: stats, gear, ancient sets, wings and pets. Type /cp, or press C and the fourth button.;Item tooltips show their CP and the change if equipped. CP opens the Tier Maps, and the site ranks the strongest by it.

data.name: KeysText
data.value: J: command list. O: event timer. N: daily rewards. X: battle pass. K: jewel bank, with the inventory open. C: character. M: warp.;The MU Helper is free: Z opens its settings, Home starts and stops it.;Camera: F10 unlocks the mouse-wheel zoom, F9 switches to the orbital camera, F11 resets it.;/cp shows your Combat Power. The website skynet-mu.net has the rankings, the auction and the wiki with every rule: skynet-mu.net/wiki.
